summary.limitation: Sensitivity of fixed co-adapted KeyOnly weights to the two past K taps, retaining the current tap. Off is not original CNN or a retrained current-only model. Current-only linear K gain is absorbable into the common K projection and is not a new CNN contribution. Unchanged memory tensors can receive different attention allocation. No generalization, causal or significance claim.
